title: hyptis alata subsp. rugosula
intro: Hyptis alata subsp. rugosula, commonly known as the Brazilian hyptis, is a plant species native to South America, particularly in Brazil. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Hyptis alata subsp. rugosula include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
